Speaker: Lira
Text: It's strange being back with people. In The Fade, I only had the echoes for company. They're not great conversationalists.

Speaker: Lira
Text: But they taught me something — every person leaves an impression on reality. Even after they're gone.

Speaker: Lira
Text: Dad thinks I don't remember Mom. I do. I remember her laugh, and the way she'd sing while cooking.

Speaker: Lira
Text: The Fade showed me echoes of her. It was cruel and kind at the same time.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I can feel the rift in everything now. In the ground, in the air, in people. It's like a heartbeat that's slightly off.

Speaker: Lira
Text: When we heal it, I wonder... will I still be able to feel it? Will I still be me?

Speaker: Lira
Text: I used to be scared of the dark. Now I've lived in a place where light and dark have no meaning.

Speaker: Lira
Text: I'm not scared anymore. Not of the dark, not of Draven, not of what comes next. Because I'm not alone.

Speaker: Lira
Text: After this is over, I want to learn how to build things. Like Dad. But not just machines — bridges between worlds.

Speaker: Lira
Text: The rift doesn't have to be a wound. It could be a door. And doors are meant to be opened — together.
